data.body: Parity gap (RP-record-parity-audit): api.records has record_merge, record_split, record_supersede and record_restore, but surfaces/declared/recordkinds.py VERBS stops at list show add edit remove search revise history, so no data kind can merge, split, supersede or restore from the CLI or MCP.
